office_does: Decides appeals, most of them from Superior Courts, on the state's intermediate appellate court, which must accept all appeals filed; six-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Court of Appeals Judge Bill A. Bowman, appointed in 2020, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Court of Appeals Division I judge since 2020 and its Acting Chief Judge; previously a King County Superior Court judge (2011-2020), public defender, and deputy prosecutor.
highlights: Appointed to the Court of Appeals in January 2020; Acting Chief Judge for Division One [S1][S2]
King County Superior Court judge 2011-2020, including Assistant Presiding Judge [S1][S2]
Former public defender and deputy prosecuting attorney [S1][S2]
